mapper.select: SELECT apr90_disposal_list_id AS disposal_list_id , apr90_appr_id AS appr_id , apr90_reg_date AS reg_date , appr.title AS title , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', appr.status_cd, apr90_company_id, appr.reg_date) AS status_name , apr90_reason AS reason , apr90_confirm_yn AS confirm_yn , f_emp_kor_nm(apr90_confirm_emp_id) AS confirm_emp_name , apr90_confirm_date AS confirm_date FROM apr90_disposal_list LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_title AS title , apr01_status_cd AS status_cd , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date FROM apr01_appr WHERE 1=1 UNION ALL SELECT apr99_appr_id AS appr_id , apr99_title AS title , apr99_status_cd AS status_cd , apr99_reg_date AS reg_date FROM apr99_appr_del WHERE 1=1 ) appr ON appr.appr_id = apr90_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND apr90_reg_emp_id = #{c.personId} AND apr90_reg_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate} AND #{c.closeDate} ORDER BY apr90_reg_date , appr.title DESC
